title: Research sprint goal: Land snags: session-end distill, a stopped land's worktree, an orchestrator behind main and a racy hook test
goal: The sprint goal's open questions are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, and the findings are written as kb facts and gap entries through the kb skills, so each committed item can name the knowledge it needs. Weak or none in the kb at planning: (1) how git worktree add <path> <branch> checks an existing local branch out again after its worktree was removed; (2) why git refuses to rebase or switch a branch that is checked out in another worktree; (3) whether a process's current working directory keeps a directory from being removed on macOS and Linux (the kb has the Windows rule only). Good already: SessionEnd hooks in headless runs (claude/hooks.md). Tested rows for kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv are a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): a story finished with them lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS, not done --commit.
